```yaml
id: vuln-tabby-1c077147
languages:
  - typescript
message: Potential vulnerability in SSHSession.authHandler()
severity: WARNING
metadata:
  description: |
    The `SSHSession.authHandler()` function in Tabby SSH is vulnerable to a timing attack, which could allow an attacker to bypass authentication.
  affected_functions:
    - SSHSession.authHandler()
  recommendation: Upgrade to the latest version of Tabby SSH or apply the patched code.
pattern: |
  (func.name=authHandler and func.args.length=3 and func.args[2].type=Function) and
    (
      (func.args[0].value in ["publickey", "password"] and func.args[1].value=false) or
      (func.args[0].value="none" and func.args[1].value=true)
    ) and
    (
      (func.args[2].calls.length>0 and func.args[2].calls[0].name=handleAuth) or
      (func.args[2].calls.length>1 and func.args[2].calls[1].name=handleAuth)
    )
```
